a: A module is a purchase of the Delta One AI trading engine, from 1,000 USDT, paid in USDT. It can deliver up to two times its price, price included, then it ends. The price is not refundable. Every figure is an illustration at the engine's average daily result; results and rewards are not guaranteed, and most members earn no commission at all.

On day 11 you get the Auto-Rebuy switch. ON means each day's result buys a new rebuy module; OFF means it goes to your app wallet, where you can withdraw any time (5 USDT minimum). Before day 11, every result rebuys. The Believer keeps the switch ON for the whole life and the module delivers 220% instead of 200%.

Each qualified upline position receives 2% of a contract's daily earnings, level by level, on up to 21 levels depending on rank. It is never a share of the purchase price. Every figure is an illustration at the engine's average daily result; results and rewards are not guaranteed, and most members earn no commission at all.

There are seven ranks: Fuji, Kilimanjaro, Matterhorn, Denali, Rainier, K-2 and Everest. Each unlocks three more paid levels (3 at Fuji, 21 at Everest), the entitlement goes from 6% to 42%, and the daily cap from 1,000 USDT to 7,000 USDT. Only active modules count, and ranks are rechecked at every settlement.

Each rank has a daily reward cap on the base matrix: 1,000 USDT at Fuji, 2,000 at Kilimanjaro, 3,000 at Matterhorn, 4,000 at Denali, 5,000 at Rainier, 6,000 at K-2 and 7,000 USDT at Everest. The breakage differential has no cap. Illustrations at the average; nothing is guaranteed.

The line balance rule: no single line can count for more than half of your qualifying volume at Fuji and Kilimanjaro, a third at Matterhorn and Denali, a quarter at Rainier and a fifth at K-2 and Everest. Volume above that share does not count. So build wide: more lines, not one tall tower.

The breakage differential is how leaders are paid: the gap between your rank's entitlement (6% to 42%) and the highest entitlement already claimed below you in that line, on the same contract. It has no cap and no depth limit, and the total on any contract never exceeds 42%. Stay ahead of your lines, and open new ones.

0.50% a day is the engine's average daily result, and it is the rate behind every figure. Real days vary from zero to several percent, the average can change, and nothing is guaranteed. A day with no trading profit pays nobody.

Results and commissions are credited to your app wallet in USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20). You can withdraw any time, 5 USDT minimum, instant, gas fee only. The purchase price itself is not refundable and cannot be withdrawn.
Settlement is every day at 12:00 UTC. That is when results are shared out and commissions are credited, in USDT, to the app wallet.

A Believer keeps Auto-Rebuy ON for the module's whole life. In return the module delivers 220% instead of 200% (about day 440 for a 1,000 USDT module at the average). The choice is binding until 220%. It is an illustration at the average, not a promise.

Nothing is guaranteed. Some days the result is zero, the purchase price is not refundable and can be lost in whole or in part, and most members earn no commission at all. Only purchase with money you can afford to lose. Every figure is an illustration at the engine's average daily result.

Every 100 USDT of trading profit is split 50 / 25 / 25: 50 USDT to members as their modules' daily results, 25 USDT to the compensation plan (every commission comes from here, never from a purchase) and 25 USDT to the DAO Treasury. No profit, no payout.

Rewards come two ways: 2% of each contract's daily earnings on every paid level of your rank (the base matrix, capped per day), and the breakage differential for leaders.
